sinopsis.es: Omid emigró de Irán a Francia con su familia. Tras sufrir una agresión en la que lo apuñalan en el pecho, los médicos descubren que carece de corazón. ¿Lo habrá dejado en su país?
sinopsis.en: Omid is an Iranian immigrant who came to France with his family. One evening, in the street, he is attacked and stabbed in the heart. But Omid gets back up! At the hospital, the diagnosis is blunt: he has no heart. Did he leave it behind in Iran?
